title: cipadessa baccifera
intro: Cipadessa baccifera, commonly known as the Indian alder or Himalayan alder, is a deciduous tree species native to the Himalayas and parts of Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relief from fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Cipadessa baccifera are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
